brief: My balcony is full sun with high moisture, and a cat and a dog live in the household. A sunny balcony kept wet by a drip hose, with one cat.

design.site_summary: A full sun balcony with high moisture from a drip hose, shared with a pet cat and dog.
design.layout_strategy: The planting is structured in three stacked layers: trailing foliage spills from hanging baskets along the upper railing, upright structural foliage occupies mid-height containers against the sunny wall, and a low, safe groundcover carpets the floor-level trays.
design.combination_logic: The scheme pairs the delicate, trailing white-flowered Episcia with the upright, architectural form of Allium ampeloprasum and lush fern foliage, creating a dynamic contrast of fine and coarse textures. The combination brings vibrant green foliage and seasonal summer blooms that thrive under high moisture and intense light, maintaining a lush, tropical aesthetic throughout the warmer months.

zones.placement: on the front railing, full sun with continuous high moisture from the drip hose.

plants.why: Thrives in full sun and high moisture conditions.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides a cascading trailing habit with delicate flowers that soften the hard lines of the railing.

maintenance: Water daily using the drip system to ensure constant high moisture.
Feed with a dilute liquid fertilizer every two weeks in summer.
Prune back long trailing stems in early spring to encourage bushier growth.

zones.placement: against the back wall at waist height, receiving full sun and steady moisture.

plants.why: Brings strong vertical contrast and structural height to the mid-layer.
plants.role_in_combination: Acts as the focal point with tall, upright foliage that breaks up the horizontal lines of the balcony.

maintenance: Ensure containers have excellent drainage despite the high moisture environment.
Apply a balanced granular fertilizer once in spring.
Remove any yellowing lower leaves as needed throughout the growing season.

zones.placement: on the floor near the balcony entrance, full sun and damp conditions.

plants.why: Provides a lush carpet at ground level that is easily accessible and safe for pets to interact with.
plants.role_in_combination: Fills the ground layer with a dense mat of succulent foliage that contrasts texturally with the vertical elements above.

maintenance: Trim back rampant growth monthly during summer to keep the grazing area contained.
Check soil moisture daily to prevent waterlogging around the roots.
Repot into fresh potting mix every spring to maintain vitality.

care_instructions.task: Check the drip hose emitters to ensure even water distribution across all pots.
care_instructions.frequency: Twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn.

care_instructions.task: Apply a balanced liquid fertilizer to the hanging and mid-layer containers.
Prune back trailing and grazing plants to prevent them from blocking walkways and drainage holes.

care_cautions: Overwatering and root rot may occur in the hanging baskets if the continuous drip hose remains on for too long without adequate drainage.
The full sun exposure combined with high moisture can cause fungal issues in the dense groundcover if air circulation is restricted.
Pets may over-graze the Tradescantia flumeninsis in the floor zone, requiring occasional rest periods for the plant to recover.
design.pet_safety_note: The floor grazing zone features pet-safe Tradescantia flumeninsis, allowing the cat and dog to safely interact with the greenery without risk of toxicity.
